summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various integration efforts, including enhancements to the Spark and Rust projects, as well as the management of Flink version support. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about column update file representation and the introduction of a new HTTP header in the REST spec.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes cover variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Discussion on increasing reviewer bandwidth for iceberg-rust project
Community debates Flink version support for upcoming Iceberg release
Proposal to add X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header to REST spec
